title: Cosmic Star Rider
description: A knight in glowing blue armor rides a vibrant green horse galloping through outer space. The surreal scene is filled with stars, constellations, nebulae, and bright comet trails against a deep cosmic background.
prompt: A knight wearing glowing blue metallic armor and helmet rides a muscular green horse galloping dynamically through deep space. The horse and rider are surrounded by swirling nebulae, bright stars, constellations, and luminous comet trails. Vibrant cosmic colors blend across the scene with visible brushstrokes, surreal fantasy style, epic and mystical atmosphere.
